text:
I couldn't assign PAL-3202 to bay D-05, so I made no assignment.

I signed in, opened the Warehouse page, and selected PAL-3202 in the "Pallet to place" dropdown. The bays are drawn on a canvas map that exposes no bay elements, labels or coordinates, so I couldn't find or select D-05. A click at the centre of the canvas selected nothing. The "Assign pallet" button was not pressed, and the Assignments list is still empty.

To finish, someone needs to tell me where D-05 sits on the map, or the map needs accessible bay labels.
